\# Mastering PDF reference index



Use these references when the task needs deeper theory than the main skill text should carry.



\## Documents



\### `more dsp math.pdf`

Use for:

\- DSP math details

\- derivations and implementation-level reasoning

\- numerical and transform-related questions

\- filter or dynamics math that needs more than high-level explanation



\### `advanced dsp.pdf`

Use for:

\- advanced DSP concepts

\- implementation tradeoffs

\- stage behavior reasoning

\- nonlinear, spectral, or higher-complexity processing questions



\### `Advanced Signal Processing Handbook.pdf`

Use for:

\- broader reference-grade signal-processing concepts

\- advanced filter, transform, estimation, or system-level DSP questions

\- deeper technical grounding when evaluating whether a design is serious enough for high-end commercial work



\## Usage rule



Do not cite these PDFs reflexively for every mastering question.



Use them when:

\- the task turns mathematical

\- the mechanism needs deeper derivation or formal grounding

\- a proposed DSP explanation risks becoming hand-wavy without stronger reference support
